name: spoo · webhooks
description: Webhook dispatch, consumer lag, pending depth, delivery latency and outcomes, endpoint lifecycle. Refresh 60s.

query.apl:
['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_dispatched"
| summarize total = count()
| project total

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivered" and is_test != true
| summarize total = count()
| project total

['spoo-prod']
| where event in ("webhook_delivered", "webhook_delivery_attempt_failed")
| summarize total = count(), ok = countif(event == "webhook_delivered")
| project rate = round(100.0 * ok / total, 2)

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivered"
| summarize p95 = percentile(duration_ms, 95)
| project p95

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "stream_group_stats" and ['group'] == "webhooks"
| summarize arg_max(_time, lag) by stream
| summarize lag = sum(lag)
| project lag

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_pending_depth"
| summarize arg_max(_time, total_pending)
| project total_pending

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivered" and is_test != true
| summarize p95 = percentile(latency_ms, 95)
| project p95

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_dispatched"
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event_type

['spoo-prod']
| where event in ("webhook_delivered", "webhook_delivery_attempt_failed")
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event

charts.name: Consumer lag on the webhooks group, by stream

query.apl:
['spoo-prod']
| where event == "stream_group_stats" and ['group'] == "webhooks"
| summarize max(lag) by bin_auto(_time), stream

charts.name: Pending depth: total queued and worst endpoint

query.apl:
['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_pending_depth"
| summarize total = max(total_pending), worst_endpoint = max(max_pending) by bin_auto(_time)

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivered" and is_test != true
| summarize percentiles_array(latency_ms, 50, 95, 99) by bin_auto(_time)

['spoo-prod']
| where event in ("webhook_delivered", "webhook_delivery_failed", "webhook_delivery_rate_limited", "webhook_delivery_dropped_over_cap") and is_test != true
| extend outcome = case(event == "webhook_delivered", "delivered", event == "webhook_delivery_failed", strcat("failed:", reason), event == "webhook_delivery_rate_limited", "rate_limited", "dropped_over_cap")
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), outcome

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivery_attempt_failed"
| extend code = coalesce(tostring(status_code), "transport")
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), code

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_endpoint_disabled"
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), reason

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivery_dropped_over_cap"
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event_type

['spoo-prod']
| where event in ("domain_event_sink_fallback", "webhook_executor_tick_failed", "domain_event_inline_dispatch_failed", "webhook_click_fanout_failed")
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_endpoint_depth"
| summarize pending = max(pending), last_seen = max(_time) by endpoint_id, status, user_id
| sort by pending desc
| take 10
| project endpoint_id, pending, status, user_id, last_seen

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivered"
| summarize p95 = percentile(duration_ms, 95), deliveries = count() by endpoint_id
| sort by p95 desc
| take 10

['spoo-prod']
| where event == "webhook_delivery_attempt_failed"
| summarize failures = count(), last_error = arg_max(_time, error) by endpoint_id
| sort by failures desc
| take 10
